# China Trips
> Independent travel guide for China — detailed itineraries, real budgets, honest city guides, and practical advice. Not a tour agency.

## Destinations
- [Beijing](https://china-trips.com/#destinations): History, Great Wall, Forbidden City, 3-5 day itinerary with hotels and food.
- [Shanghai](https://china-trips.com/#destinations): City skyline, Disney, French Concession, 2-4 day guide with day trips.
- [Xi'an](https://china-trips.com/#destinations): Terracotta Warriors, Ancient City Wall, Muslim Quarter food, 2-3 day guide.
- [Chengdu](https://china-trips.com/#destinations): Panda Base, Sichuan hot pot, Leshan Buddha, 3-4 day itinerary.
- [Zhangjiajie](https://china-trips.com/#destinations): Avatar mountains, glass bridge, Tianmen Mountain, 2-4 day nature guide.
- [Guilin & Yangshuo](https://china-trips.com/#destinations): Li River cruise, karst peaks, cycling, 3-4 day outdoor guide.
- [Yunnan](https://china-trips.com/#destinations): Kunming, Dali, Lijiang, Tiger Leaping Gorge, 5-7 day cultural circuit.
- [Guangzhou](https://china-trips.com/#destinations): Dim sum capital, Canton Tower, Chen Clan Academy, food-focused guide.

## About
China Trips is an independent travel guide created and maintained by travelers with firsthand China experience. All itineraries, prices, and tips are researched and regularly verified. No AI-generated filler. No sponsored rankings. Last verified: August 2026.
